evidence.quote: First, register on hochschulstart.de. There, you will be given an applicant ID (BID) and an applicant authentication number (BAN). You can then use these details to apply via uni-assist.

notes: Valid for Moroccan applicants with a Moroccan Baccalauréat. The DAAD page says foreign applicants apply via uni-assist; the programme page specifically says applicants with a school-leaving qualification obtained outside Germany register on hochschulstart.de and then apply via uni-assist (chosen as de-uni-assist per task). Tuition is general state-university policy (no tuition fees) but the quote is from a general costs page, not this programme, so tuition is omitted. The application deadline is general for all countries (winter semester, 15 July without year); details and year should be confirmed on the programme website. The DAAD page's English certificate list also includes UNIcert, telc, TOEIC, PTE Academic, Cambridge English Qualifications and IELTS 5.5; TOEFL iBT requirements are stated for 2026.

note.fr: Une expérience professionnelle préparatoire de 8 semaines est requise (à fournir au plus tard lors de la réinscription au 4e semestre).
note.en: An 8-week pre-study internship is required (to be submitted by re-enrolment in the 4th semester at the latest).

evidence.quote: Completion of an eight-week preparatory internship. This is not required for initial admission, but it must be met by the fourth semester re-enrolment deadline at the latest.
